findings.evidence: `HahnSeries.coeff.linearMap` is the canonical coefficient linear map and `AlgEquiv.toLinearMap` supplies the other component; `Laurent/Basic.lean:171` already uses `HahnSeries.coeff.linearMap` for the analogous residue construction.
findings.fix: Define it as `(HahnSeries.coeff.linearMap n).comp (P.completionEquivLaurentSeries hP ht).toLinearMap`.
findings.issue: `completionLaurentCoeff` manually reconstructs the linearity already supplied by existing linear maps.

findings.evidence: Mathlib `RingTheory/LaurentSeries.lean:544` provides `LaurentSeries.coeff_zero_of_lt_valuation`; `Laurent/Basic.lean:100-105` demonstrates the same direct proof pattern.
findings.fix: Use `LaurentSeries.coeff_zero_of_lt_valuation` together with `valuation_completionEquivLaurentSeries` and `z.2`, as the function-field analogue already does.
findings.issue: `completionLaurentCoeff_coe_integer_eq_zero` re-derives negative-coefficient vanishing through the raw `ofPowerSeries` embedding.

summary: The completed coefficient API is useful, but its definition and integral-vanishing proof reimplement existing Mathlib abstractions.
